captions: Good morning.
It's Wednesday, July twenty-second —
and here's your setup before the market opens.
We'll cover the overnight global cues,
the stocks and sectors in focus, the big results due today,
and the key Nifty levels to watch.
One important note up front —
this is a watchlist and a setup,
not a prediction of which stocks will go up.
It's information, not investment advice.
First, the overnight cues — and they're positive.
Wall Street rallied and snapped a three-day losing streak.
The tech-heavy Nasdaq jumped one point three percent as semiconductor stocks surged.
The Dow rose zero point seven four percent,
helped by earnings beats — 3M up seven percent,
General Motors up five.
GIFT Nifty was trading around twenty-four thousand one hundred; combined with that strong US close,
it points to a firm-to-positive open for our market.
The tech strength is a tailwind for Indian IT after its recent weakness.
But one thing hasn't changed —
Brent crude near ninety dollars remains the key risk to watch.
Now, the stocks and sectors in focus at the open.
First — I-T.
With the Nasdaq up one point three percent overnight, TCS,
Infosys and the I-T pack could see a tailwind after their recent weakness.
Second — autos.
TVS Motor posted an all-time-high quarterly profit and its stock jumped six percent; Bajaj Auto's profit rose forty-six percent.
Watch the whole auto ecosystem react.
Third — the oil marketing companies, B-P-C-L and H-P-C-L.
Both report today, and with crude near ninety dollars,
their marketing margins are under the spotlight.
Fourth — financials.
IndusInd Bank reports today,
closely watched after HDFC and Axis margin misses hit the sector.
Bandhan Bank and M&M Financial both beat yesterday.
Today is another huge earnings day —
over fifty-four companies report.
Here are the big ones.
IndusInd Bank — likely the day's most important result.
After HDFC and Axis missed on margins,
the market wants to see if the private-bank stress is spreading.
Nestle India and United Spirits — F-M-C-G bellwethers.
Watch volume growth and rural demand.
Doctor Reddy's and S-R-F — pharma,
especially after Cipla's weak day,
and S-R-F for a read on chemicals.
And the high-beta names — Adani Power, Adani Green,
and Eternal, the company behind Zomato.
These can move sharply on their numbers.
Others reporting include Tata Communications, J-S-W Energy,
and Nippon Life A-M-C.
So what's the overall setup?
It's a tug of war.
On the headwind side —
Brent crude near ninety dollars on Middle East tension,
the Nifty falling two days in a row,
and foreign investors selling.
On the tailwind side —
a strong US close with the Nasdaq up one point three percent lifting I-T,
positive market breadth with midcaps in the green,
and the Nifty still holding key support.
For levels —
watch support at twenty-four thousand fifty to twenty-four thousand one hundred,
and resistance at twenty-four thousand three hundred to three fifty.
The outlook is sideways-to-bullish,
with the range between twenty-four thousand fifty and twenty-four thousand three fifty.
Finally, five things to remember as the market opens.
One — this is a watchlist and a setup,
not a prediction of which stocks will rise.
Nobody can promise that.
Two — GIFT Nifty points to a firm open,
but let the first fifteen minutes settle before acting on any gap.
Three —
keep the Nifty range in mind: around twenty-four thousand fifty as support,
twenty-four thousand three fifty as resistance.
Four — with so many earnings today,
expect sharp single-stock moves.
Always use a stop-loss.
Five —
the two swing factors today are crude near ninety dollars,
and how I-T reacts to that strong Nasdaq lead.
July twenty-second, pre-market at a glance.
US markets rose — Nasdaq up one point three percent,
Dow up zero point seven — a tech tailwind.
GIFT Nifty points to a firm-to-positive open.
In focus — I-T on the US boost, autos on earnings,
and the oil marketing companies on crude.
Today's big results — IndusInd Bank, Nestle, Doctor Reddy's,
B-P-C-L, and the Adani pack.
And the levels —
Nifty support near twenty-four thousand fifty,
resistance near twenty-four thousand three fifty.
Remember — this is a watchlist, not a forecast.
Trade the reaction, not the prediction.
This information is aggregated from public sources —
for analysis only, not investment advice.
Have a great trading day, and thanks for watching.
